paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讲的是家人努力帮助彼此，哪怕他们并不完全明白，对方真正需要的是什么。

菲尔的父亲弗兰克突然开着房车从佛罗里达来到他们家。他带来了一条叫斯考特的狗，并说菲尔的母亲原本想养它，后来才发现自己对狗过敏。孩子们立刻爱上了斯考特，克莱尔却并不高兴。她知道所有人都会答应帮忙，最后大部分工作还是会落到她一个人身上。

克莱尔听到弗兰克独自在房车里哭后，变得更加担心。因为弗兰克和妻子几乎从不分开，她怀疑两人的婚姻出了问题。菲尔不相信，因为父亲一直都很开朗，而且父子俩平时总会用开玩笑的方式躲开严肃谈话。

菲尔问弗兰克是不是出了什么事，弗兰克说自己没事，并迅速换了话题。后来，他宣布自己又要离开了，但不是开车回家，而是准备一个人继续旅行。这终于让菲尔觉得，克莱尔的猜测也许是对的。

弗兰克出发前，菲尔直接问他到底发生了什么。弗兰克承认，自己爱上了某个对象，但他说的其实是斯考特。和这条狗一起在路上生活了几天后，他已经无法接受把它留下。菲尔和孩子们同样已经对斯考特产生了感情，但菲尔意识到，这条狗真正应该陪着父亲，于是让弗兰克把它带走了。

与此同时，杰把曼尼从学校接出来去看电影，希望给他一个特别的下午，就像自己小时候曾经和父亲度过的那一天。可惜，他选的是一部恐怖片。曼尼被吓坏了，开始觉得电影里的杀手无处不在。

格洛丽亚非常生气，但杰说，害怕也是成长的一部分。为了补救，他邀请了电影演员本过来，向曼尼解释一切都是假的。本手里拿着一把橡胶砍刀，毫无预警地敲响了曼尼的窗户。他不但没有让曼尼平静下来，反而把全家人都吓坏了，最后所有人只好挤在同一张床上睡觉。

在米切尔和卡梅隆家，迪伦的乐队突然缺少一名鼓手。卡梅隆以前教过音乐，马上主动提出代替。米切尔很不高兴，因为他们已经答应去参加朋友佩珀的派对，但卡梅隆承认，整天留在家里照顾莉莉让他变得很烦躁。他需要一件属于自己的事。

米切尔来到演出现场，原本只准备停留几分钟，可看到卡梅隆在台上如此开心，他还是留下来支持他。卡梅隆表演了一段长得离谱的鼓独奏，还以为自己终于在乐队里找到了新位置。结果原来的鼓手回来了，他的音乐事业几乎刚开始就结束了。

到了最后，菲尔终于和父亲进行了一次更坦诚的谈话，卡梅隆得到了一晚时间，重新感觉像从前的自己，而杰试图治好曼尼恐惧的计划，只让全家人变得更加害怕。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about family members trying to help one another, even when they don’t fully understand what the other person needs.

Phil’s father, Frank, unexpectedly arrives from Florida in an RV. He brings a dog named Scout and says Phil’s mother wanted him but discovered she’s allergic. The children immediately love Scout, but Claire isn’t happy. She knows everyone will promise to help and she’ll end up doing most of the work.

Claire becomes more concerned after she hears Frank crying alone in the RV. Since he and his wife almost never spend time apart, she suspects there’s a problem in their marriage. Phil doesn’t believe it because his father is always cheerful, and the two of them usually avoid serious conversations by making jokes.

Phil asks Frank if anything is wrong, but Frank says he’s fine and changes the subject. Later, he announces that he’s leaving again, but instead of driving home, he plans to keep traveling by himself. This finally convinces Phil that Claire may be right.

Just before Frank leaves, Phil asks him directly what’s going on. Frank admits that he’s fallen in love, but he means Scout. After several days on the road with the dog, he can’t stand the idea of leaving him behind. Phil and the kids have also become attached to Scout, but Phil realizes the dog belongs with his father and lets Frank take him.

Meanwhile, Jay takes Manny out of school to see a movie, hoping to give him the kind of special day he once had with his own father. Unfortunately, he chooses a horror movie. Manny becomes terrified and starts imagining that the killer is everywhere.

Gloria is furious, but Jay says being scared is part of growing up. To fix the problem, he invites Ben, an actor from the movie, to explain that everything was fake. Ben arrives holding a rubber machete and knocks on Manny’s window without warning. Instead of calming him down, he scares the whole family, and they all end up sleeping in the same bed.

At Mitchell and Cameron’s house, Dylan suddenly needs a drummer for his band. Cameron used to teach music and quickly offers to fill in. Mitchell is annoyed because they already promised to attend their friend Pepper’s party, but Cameron admits that staying home with Lily all day has made him restless. He needs something of his own.

Mitchell goes to the concert planning to stay for only a few minutes, but Cameron is so happy onstage that he stays to support him. Cameron performs an extremely long drum solo and thinks he has found a new place in the band. Then the original drummer returns, so his music career ends almost as soon as it begins.

By the end, Phil has a more honest conversation with his father, Cameron gets a night to feel like his old self again, and Jay’s attempt to cure Manny’s fear only makes the whole family more frightened.
